text: {"name":"rf_update_rssi","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Computes a clamped RF-level delta, programs and stores it, then clears a status byte or copies a selected table block according to the -61 threshold.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"rf_state","v1":"measured_level","v2":"level_delta","v4":"table_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":5,"meaning":"Input byte used to compute the RF-level sample"},{"offset":7,"meaning":"Stored computed RF-level delta"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit selector for the source block, using a 30,000-byte stride"},{"offset":11,"meaning":"Status byte cleared when the computed value is below -61"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Destination buffer for the selected block copy"}]}
